original_open_archive.study_name: Eurasian griffon vulture in France ID_PROG 961

preheight_population.study_native_label: Eurasian griffon vulture in France ID_PROG 961
preheight_population.source_GPS_rows: Only rows with native taxon Gyps fulvus, valid individual ID/date/XY, ground speed 5–55m/s, visible!=false, import-marked-outlier!=true
preheight_population.selection: EARLIEST eligible GPS row (GPS altitude unseen) per individual×UTC date×5min timestamp bucket across all 9 seasonal source files.
preheight_population.speed_units: Movebank ground-speed, m/s; no inference of flapping/soaring from speed alone.
preheight_population.xy_projection: EPSG:6933 WGS84 equal-area for comparable 5/50km units
preheight_population.tag_alias_guard: Compute exact biological bird ID -> unique original tag IDs and GPS quality coverage per panel/year. Do not treat a biological bird with two tags as two individuals.

independence_guard.original_Gyps_tracking_source: Scacco et al 2026 10.5281/zenodo.21915776; previously evaluated 4 panels
independence_guard.declared_parent_France: Eurasian griffon vulture in France ID_PROG 961
independence_guard.require: Verify this France dataset's Movebank parent study ID against old Scacco two IDs and compare literal biological bird, tag and deployment identifiers with original Gyps output before claiming a new independent replication. Source author involvement alone does not guarantee biological overlap/nonoverlap.
independence_guard.if_unresolved: Label independent origin UNVERIFIED and stop before categorizing new significant ecological replication.
independence_guard.data_license: CC BY 4.0; cite Sassi (2024), underlying tracking owners and relevant 2024 Ornithological Applications publication.

instrument_opportunity.nonheight_HDOP_completeness: fraction of time-selected fixes with finite native GPS HDOP; no QC dropping based on value at this gate
instrument_opportunity.nonheight_satellite_count_completeness: fraction with finite satellite count and numeric range; do not drop rows
instrument_opportunity.barometric_pressure_height: COLUMN EXISTS, but never inspect its numeric values or missingness until after x-y and source overlap support frozen
instrument_opportunity.GPS_height: COLUMN EXISTS, but never inspect its numeric values or missingness until after x-y and source overlap support frozen
instrument_opportunity.uncertain_sensor_behavior: Accel XYZ fields may not be recorded at native GPS fix cadence; do not infer flight mode without validating their source units and completeness AFTER population freeze.

next_if_gate_passes.environment: Externally acquired CERRA/ERA5 site/day wind and solar or boundary-layer covariates; repeat exact 5km cell and flight mode where feasible
next_if_gate_passes.primary_biology: On new independent source, compare bird-specific wind response against the source species-shared environmental response using same fixed GPS height target events. GPS sensor errors should be independently calibrated using the source's HDOP, satellite and dual GPS/barometric recording.
next_if_gate_passes.preanalysis_work: Freeze all source year/cell/individual/source-device IDs and choose weather label bins before opening numerical GPS height
next_if_gate_passes.no_rescue: If 5km cannot be evaluated, 50km remains a separate migration habitat estimand and must be frozen before native altitude outcome inspection; don't open and tune
